Name: Horror Hats
Author: Pinheadius
Description:
[u][b][font=Courier New][size=4][center]Description[/center][/size][/font][/b][/u]
[size=3]Adds 13 horror stylede hats to Hat Mouse shop without replacing vanilla hats and therefore requires SMAPI and Json Assets 1.2+[/size]

[size=3]Different Zombies, Skulls and some others, look at the pictures.[/size]

[size=3]I'll keep updating.[/size]
[size=3](thinking about adding more masks of our beloved towns people...)[/size]



[u][b][font=Courier New][size=4][center]List so far[/center][/size][/font][/b][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]4x Zombie masks[/size]
[*][size=3]Dwarvish mask (has a minor clipping issue, download the optional file without it)[/size]
[*][size=3]Ghostface killer mask[/size]
[*][size=3]4x Skull masks[/size]
[*][size=3]Major Lewis mask (Marnie won't know the difference) (has a minor clipping issue, download the optional file without it)[/size]
[*][size=3]2x Devil masks[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]Enjoy.[/size]



[u][font=Courier New][size=4][b][center]Installation[/center][/b][/size][/font]
[/u][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/index.php?title=Modding:SMAPI_compatibility&oldid=74245#Json_Assets]Json Assets 1.2+[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
